groups.saying_opens: إن ناسا أعمى الله قلوبهم كما أعمى أبصارهم

levels.surface: خالد بن المهاجر بن سيف الله

groups.saying_opens: إنها كانت رخصة في أول الإسلام
قد كنت استمتعت في عهد رسول الله

notes: Three sayings, each with its own isnad: Ibn al-Zubayr's speech, Ibn Abi Amra's words in Khalid's account, and Rabi' b. Sabra's report of his father's words (rule 4a); each group carries its saying.
Later sayings open with «قال ابن شهاب» and keep the shared head up to Ibn Shihab (rule 4a).
«عند رجل جاءه رجل» is a place and an asker in the scene, not links (rule 6).
Zuhri's remark that he heard Rabi' tell it to Umar b. Abd al-Aziz is a scene, not a route, and is left out.
«أن أباه قال»: a bare «أباه» with no name is a relation link (rule 7).
